title: qos.dem's 01000ms.png shifted but the re-bless cause-doc enumerates only the 65s capture — sim-verified honest pressure, doc gap only
evidence:
diff: "diff --git a/goldens/qos/01000ms.png b/goldens/qos/01000ms.png\nindex 5ce1443..9d269e9 100644\nBinary files a/goldens/qos/01000ms.png and b/goldens/qos/01000ms.png differ"
spec Design Notes: "Traffic demos additionally shift where the demo itself strains: sla.dem / qos_contention.dem gain rings in strained captures; qos.dem's 65 s capture gains the panel + surge-strain; qos_emphasis.dem gains rings if its captures strain."
detail: The spec's per-demo cause list names only qos.dem's 65s capture, yet the 1000ms frame also shifted. Sim probe at the sha (tick 20): "20 p0=Red,p1=Red,p2=Red,p3=Red w=0" — all pipes Red, zero waiting packets, panel empty (surge lead opens tick 600). 24 on-edge packets = 6/pipe = the E9 bound; per-tick drops run from tick 4. The shift is the honest pressure telegraph (same bundle_lane_count the E9 ladder uses), not an unaccounted shift or flicker — the cause-doc enumeration simply missed the frame.
recommended_fix: Add qos.dem's 1000ms capture to the cause-documented T2 shift list in the spec (pressure halos: lanes at the E9 bound from tick 4).
